questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

North America : Mexico :: South America : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **The second word is a country of the first word which is a continent.**

**North America : Mexico**

→ Mexico is a country in North America continent.

Similarly,

**South America : ?**

→ Venezuela is a country in South America continent.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Venezuela"**.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All motors are ships.

Some ships are bowls.

No ship is a hammer.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some motors are hammers.

(II) Some bowls are motors.

(III) Some bowls are not hammers.

options.text: Either conclusion I or conclusion III follows
All the conclusions I, II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4011cff0d58a65754abde889719be830d801cb10a130f6c751aa3214cc69b6e8.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some motors are hammers → **False** (All motors are ships, and no ship is hammer implies that no motor is hammer).

(II) Some bowls are motors → **False** (All motors are ships, and some ships are bowls implies that some bowls can be motors. This is possible but not definite).

(III) Some bowls are not hammers → **True** (All motors are ships, some ships are bowls, and no ship is a hammer implies that some bowls which are ships are not hammer).

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Only conclusion III follows"**.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by Two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some markers are frogs.

All frogs are combs.

No comb is a stove.

**Conclusions:**

I. All markers being stove is a possibility.

II. Some combs are markers.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c90415256ed59a08919bf6ad5cdc463a85a6f444d00351cca2446056e4f577e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All markers being stove is a possibility → False (Because, those part of frogs which is market can never be stove).

II. Some combs are markers → **True** (Because, those part of markers which is frogs will definitely combs).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows"**.

questions.question: 26 is related to 12 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 36 is related to 18. Which of the following is related to 20 using the same logic?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Second number = Product of the digits of first number**

**26 is related to 12,**

→ 12 = 2 × 6 

**36 is related to 18,**

18 = 3 × 6 

**? is related to 20,**

→ From the given options, only the product of digits of Option 4 (45) is 20.

Hence, the correct answer is **"45"**.
